open_points.subject: open_store and record_change spool cleanup
open_points.text: - record_change: [PATH_OR_ARTIFACT_POLICY] Durability order: every file a change names is published, fsynced and its directory fsynced before the change is committed, and the SQLite database runs with synchronous FULL, so after a power loss a committed record never names a missing or partial file; a file published by a change that then failed stays unnamed until the next start removes it (A18 rule 4).
open_points.other_text: - open_store: [RETURN_SHAPE] Returns StoreOpened with data_directory and temporary_files_removed, the count of temporary files removed, unnamed value files not counted; no record, named value file or spool is removed by this call.
open_points.question: Must the next open remove unnamed published spool files left by failed changes, or must open_store never remove spool files?
